name: hairbydemj
description: hairbydemj.com store: website, admin and API server

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server/db/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:status: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server/db/cli.js status
scripts.db:seed: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server/db/cli.js seed
scripts.staff:invite-owner: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server/accounts/cli.js invite-owner
scripts.staff:reset-access: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server/accounts/cli.js reset-access
